[B1] < cloudA | UserX : ('members' : Members , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'invite' cloudA | UserY
=> < cloudA | UserX : ('members' : (UserY , Members) , ...) , ... > .

[B1] < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : DeviceX , 'members' : (UserY , Members) , ...) , UserY : ('device' : nils , ...) , ... >
=> < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : DeviceX , 'members' : (UserY , Members) , ...) , UserY : ('device' : DeviceX , ...) , ... > .

[B2] < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : DeviceX , ...) , ... > < DeviceX | 'key' : Key , ... > $ UserX 'requestKey' cloudA | DeviceX
=> < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : DeviceX , ...) , ... > < DeviceX | 'key' : Key , ... > $ cloudA 'sendKey' UserX | (DeviceX ; Key) .

[B2] < UserX | 'key' : nils , ... > $ cloudA 'sendKey' UserX | (DeviceX ; Key)
=> < UserX | 'key' : Key , ... > .

[B3] < DeviceX | 'key' : Key , 'on' : false , ... > $ UserX 'turnOnWithKey' DeviceX | Key
=> < DeviceX | 'key' : Key , 'on' : true , ... > .

[B4] < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : DeviceX , ...) , ... > < DeviceX | 'on' : false , ... > $ UserX 'turnOn' cloudA | DeviceX
=> < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : DeviceX , ...) , ... > < DeviceX | 'on' : true , ... > .

[B5] < cloudA | UserX : ('members' : (UserY , Members) , ...) , UserY : ('device' : DeviceY , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'removeMember' cloudA | UserY
=> < cloudA | UserX : ('members' : Members , ...) , UserY : ('device' : nils , ...) , ... > .

< cloudA | (userA : ('device' : deviceB , 'members' : nils) , userC : ('device' : nils , 'members' : nils)) >
< deviceB | ('on' : false , 'key' : 'keyB') >
< userA | ('key' : nils) >
< userC | ('key' : nils) >

[B1] < UserX | ... > < UserY | ... > => ev1(UserX, UserY) .
[B2] < UserX | ... > < DeviceX | ... > => ev2(UserX, DeviceX) .
[B3] < UserX | 'key' : Key , ... > < DeviceX | ... > => ev3(UserX, DeviceX, Key) .
[B4] < UserX | ... > < DeviceX | ... > => ev4(UserX, DeviceX) .
[B5] < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : DeviceX , 'members' : (UserY) , ...) , ... > => ev5(UserX, UserY) .
